meta.title: Blender annotate
meta.description: Preview .blend files using your existing headless Blender and annotate any surface point. A click retains the export revision, object/node, triangle and barycentric coordinates, plus available source face provenance, nearest source edge/vertex, face parameters, UV and local/world mm. Choose Point, Face, Edge, Vertex or Object, add comments, and send structured references plus a pinned snapshot to chat. Sketch adds boxes, circles, arrows and text. Stale annotations are retained but not drawn against changed geometry. Source parameters and edge/vertex snaps describe the pre-modifier cage, not guaranteed unchanged topology. Read-only or generated geometry may be evaluated-surface only. Static shape-key mixes are supported; textures, skinning and animation playback are not.
